## What this case checks

Expose clustering logic that fails to connect a transitive dateline-spanning cluster when distances are measured in an unsuitable local projection.

## Risk types covered

- [`coordinate_wrapping`](../risk/coordinate-wrapping.md)
- `local_projection_distortion`
- `transitive_cluster_split`

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_valid_geometry` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `Point` |

## Notes

This fixture places three points around the antimeridian. Geodesically they
form one connected component under a `50 km` threshold, but naive projected
clustering can incorrectly split them into multiple clusters.

## Required capabilities

- `load`
- `geometry-validation`
- `proximity-check`
